questions.prompt: What fraction does the shaded part show?

choices.feedback: The shaded part is 3 out of 6 equal parts, so it is 3/6.
1/3 is 2/6, but the shaded part is 3 out of 6.
3/3 is the whole, but only 3 of the 6 parts are shaded.

hints: Count the total equal parts in the bar (the denominator).
questions.explanation: The bar is split into 6 equal parts, 3 of them shaded, so the fraction is 3/6.

choices.text: A bar split into 5 equal parts with 2 shaded
A bar split into 2 equal parts with 5 shaded
choices.feedback: 2/5 has 5 equal parts and 2 shaded. A bar split into 2 parts cannot show 2/5.

choices.text: A bar split into 5 equal parts with 3 shaded
A bar split into 5 equal parts with 2 unshaded
choices.feedback: 2 unshaded parts means 3 are shaded, so it is 3/5.

hints: The denominator is the total number of equal parts.
The numerator is the number of shaded parts.
questions.explanation: 2/5 means 5 equal parts with 2 shaded. A bar split into 5 parts with 2 shaded matches.
